title: AgentsDeployOutput
description: Output of `gentry agents deploy --json`: the subagents are laid out in every worktree of the pool of the project.

changed.description: Whether the layout changed any worktree.

worktrees.description: Every worktree of the pool, the main one first, then by path; empty if no AI tool is connected.

tools.description: The AI tools connected, in whose format the subagents are laid out, in the order claude, codex; empty if none is connected: then nothing is laid out.
